title: ReflectRec: Cycle-Consistency Preference Verification for LLM-based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CoT-style LLM recommenders generate a natural-language preference note as a chain-of-thought prefix to ranking, but the note is trusted without verification, and the ranker never consults behaviorally similar users. We propose ReflectRec, organized around a preference-to-history round-trip verifier whose recall score serves as an operational signal of preference-to-history recoverability, enabling conditional regeneration for low-recoverability preferences and selection among regeneration attempts. Around this verifier, we wire a semantic Stage-1 prompt, conditional regeneration, and Forward-Look retrieval that injects future watches of behaviorally similar users as a collaborative hint. On MovieLens-100K and MovieLens-1M, the full pipeline outperforms CoT4Rec-ICL by +16.25 / +4.46 pp Hit@10, with positive gains across all ValScore buckets and three LLM backbones (Qwen3-30B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3.3-70B). translated_title: ReflectRec：面向基于大语言模型推荐的循环一致性偏好验证
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）风格的大语言模型推荐器会生成一段自然语言偏好笔记，作为排序前的思维链前缀，但该笔记在未经验证的情况下就被直接信任，且排序器从不参考行为相似的用户。我们提出了ReflectRec，其核心是一个“偏好到历史”的往返验证器，该验证器的召回分数可作为偏好可恢复性的操作性信号，从而支持对低可恢复性偏好进行条件性再生成，并在多次再生成尝试中做出选择。围绕该验证器，我们构建了语义化的第一阶段提示、条件性再生成机制，以及“前瞻检索”，后者将行为相似用户的未来观看记录作为协同信号注入。在MovieLens-100K和MovieLens-1M数据集上，完整流水线在Hit@10指标上分别以+16.25和+4.46个百分点的优势超越CoT4Rec-ICL，且在所有ValScore分桶以及三种大语言模型骨干（Qwen3-30B、Qwen2.5-72B和Llama-3.3-70B）上均取得正向提升。我们还观察到类似的验证……
tldr: ReflectRec通过偏好-历史往返验证器对LLM生成的偏好笔记进行循环一致性校验，结合低质量偏好的条件性再生成与行为相似用户未来行为的前瞻检索，在MovieLens数据集上显著提升推荐性能。
